meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Acne-prone skin ke liye **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** sabse practical choice hai—especially agar blackheads, whiteheads, oily skin ya active pimples hain. Iski price aam taur par ₹224–₹521 ke beech milti hai.[1][2][8]

### ₹700 ke andar best options

- **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — ₹224–₹521  
  Active acne, clogged pores aur blackheads ke liye best.[1][2]

- **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — lagbhag ₹179–₹448  
  Oily skin aur active breakouts ke liye budget option.[2][10]

- **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Serum** — lagbhag ₹449–₹526  
  2% salicylic acid + 5% niacinamide; acne ke saath acne marks bhi hon to useful.[1][2]

- **Minimalist 5% Niacinamide + 1% Hyaluronic Acid** — ₹399–₹569  
  Agar acne mild hai, skin sensitive hai, ya main concern oiliness aur acne marks hain.[7]

**Meri recommendation:**  
- **Active pimples/blackheads:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid  
- **Sensitive skin ya sirf acne marks:** Minimalist 5% Niacinamide  
- **Acne + marks dono:** The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide

**Kaise use karein:** Raat mein clean, dry face par 2–3 drops, pehle haftे mein **alternate nights**. Ek hi active serum use karein; salicylic acid ke saath retinol, AHA/BHA ya strong vitamin C same routine mein na milayein. Moisturizer aur din mein SPF 30+ zaroor lagayein. Salicylic acid 2% ko acne ke liye alternate nights se shuru karna recommended hai.[4]

Agar pimples deep, painful ya cyst-like hain, serum ke bajay dermatologist ko dikhana better hai.[4]
